messages:
ashley: follow-up from last night's postmortem  we still have 3 open remediation items. main asks: assign clear R/A, add one-line acceptance criteria, and attach rollback commands.
diego: i'll own the cache TTL drift (JIRA: RMD-10222). plan: reproduce, add histogram metrics, and propose config fix. R: diego, A: mona, C: liam. ETA: Thu EOD.
mona: i'll approve the change once the canary results look good. please add a 1-line AC in the ticket (repro + canary pass).
liam: i'll prepare a short rollback snippet and a smoke test, adding it to RMD-10222 now. also noticed this matches a pattern from Feb  linking the old incident in the ticket.
ashley: process ask: let's enforce single R + single A per ticket and an 'audit-close' field in jira with who closed + timestamp. this will help compliance and avoid ownership drift.
diego: +1. also adding label `recurring-pattern` to RMD-10222 and linking EPIC-10250 "recurring-cache-issues".
pm-bot: RMD-10222 created and assigned to diego. reminder set for 2026-04-06T17:00:00Z.
mona: another item: autoscaler spike (RMD-10230)  small config misapply. propose R: mona, A: ashley, canary Mon 09:00 UTC. i'll add canary steps: ```
1) deploy config to 5% pool
2) monitor error rate in 1m windows
3) abort if error > 0.5% or latency > 2x baseline
```
liam: created EPIC-10250 and added both tickets as children. i'll also spin up a small dashboard with 60d error trends. link coming.
ashley: timeline lock: RMD-10222 (diego) Thu EOD, RMD-10230 (mona) canary Mon. we'll have a 15m sync Mon 10:15 UTC to confirm canary status. everyone, please add AC and rollback command to your Jira ticket now.
diego: will post metrics and repro script to RMD-10222 before EOD Wed.
mona: will add the PR + rollback one-liner to 10230 and run canary Monday.
liam: dashboard draft: https://grafana.internal/d/epic-10250 (WIP). feedback welcome.
pm-bot: Follow-up sync scheduled 2026-04-06T10:15:00Z.
ashley: thanks all. i'll update the RACI doc after the canary window to reflect the new single R/A rule and the audit-close requirement. marking thread status: follow-up in progress. :thumbsup:
